items.title: Identification of Urinary Extracellular Vesicle-Derived MicroRNAs as Sensitive and Specific Biomarkers for Early-Stage Feline Chronic Kidney Disease
items.summary: Chronic kidney disease is diagnosed late in cats, after substantial and irreversible loss of functional kidney tissue. This project isolates microRNAs carried in urinary extracellular vesicles and tests whether their expression patterns distinguish early-stage disease from healthy aging.
items.significance: A validated urine test would move feline CKD diagnosis earlier, when dietary and therapeutic intervention still changes the trajectory of disease.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence for Canine Hip Dysplasia Screening
items.summary: Automated analysis of hip-extended radiographs to support consistent canine hip dysplasia grading, with translational relevance to human orthopedic screening.
items.significance: Consistent, reproducible grading reduces inter-observer variability in a screening programme that shapes breeding decisions across the population.

items.title: AI-Assisted Interpretation of the Saline Agglutination Test
items.summary: Machine-learning support for reading the saline agglutination test, distinguishing true agglutination from rouleaux more consistently than visual assessment alone.
